opening.text: I'm here because I have pain. It came on fairly quickly, and it feels tender and burning. I'd rate the intensity as 3 out of 10. I also have a cough, and I'm dealing with a stuffy nose or a clear runny nose. Just so you know, my immune system is suppressed. In the past 2 weeks, I've been around someone with similar symptoms, and I live with 4 or more people.
